fate.display: Perished after deportation to Auschwitz in 1944.

biography: He was a fabric merchant from a Ladino-speaking Jewish family in Bitola. He later fled to Greece.

facts.text: Deported by train from Salonika to Auschwitz on 1 April 1944.
